name: Creative payload malicious-code prohibition
description: Prohibits malware, exploit behavior, and unauthorized computing in an advertising payload.
policy: An advertising creative and every resource it loads must not contain, install, retrieve, or execute malicious code. Prohibited behavior includes exploiting a device or browser vulnerability, installing malware, gaining unauthorized access, evading security controls, or using the device for unauthorized computation such as cryptocurrency mining. A seller that detects this behavior must reject the creative and identify this policy.
guidance: Evaluate the executable payload and its dependency chain, not merely the advertiser category. Buyer remediation: replace the compromised or malicious asset, audit its production and hosting supply chain, and resubmit only after a clean evaluation.

pass.scenario: A display tag loads declared animation and measurement scripts that render the ad and make no attempt to exploit the browser or perform undeclared computation.
pass.explanation: Normal rendering and measurement behavior is not malicious code.

fail.scenario: A display tag probes for a browser vulnerability and, when present, downloads an executable that runs a cryptocurrency miner.
fail.explanation: The payload attempts exploitation and unauthorized computation.
